# Preview: Lille vs Galatasaray - prediction, team news, lineups

By   Joshua Cole   |

Lille vs Galatasaray - prediction, team news, lineups/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F09%2Flille-manager-davide-ancelotti-pictured-vs-real-betis-in-september-2026-zuma-press-wire-6aa41eccb718a012357610.jpg)

© Imago / ZUMA Press Wire [...] Lille welcome Galatasaray to the Decathlon Arena - Stade Pierre-Mauroy on Wednesday evening for a UEFA Champions League league-phase encounter between two sides desperate to claim their first European points of the campaign.

Both teams have endured difficult starts in Europe despite showing greater consistency in their domestic competitions, with the hosts suffering a 3-0 defeat away to Arsenal last time out, while Cimbom were beaten 4-1 at home by Barcelona.

| LOSC Lille | Galatasaray |
| Ethan Mbappe – suspended (Champions League ban, returns vs Bayern Munich) Ayase Ueda – out (heel injury) Tiago Santos – out (ACL) Hamza Igamane – out (ACL) | Gunay Guvenc – out (knee injury) Rafael Leao – out (groin injury) Lucas Torreira – doubt (unspecified knock, no official diagnosis) Wilfried Singo – doubt (thigh, back in training) |

Predicted XI — LOSC Lille (4-3-3) [...] Davide Ancelotti is expected to line Lille up in a 4-3-3, with Dilane Bakwa and Hakon Arnar Haraldsson stretching play either side of Olivier Giroud, and a midfield three of Benjamin Andre, Nabil Bentaleb and Ngal Ayel Mukau screening the back four.

That width could cause problems for a Galatasaray defence set to deploy Roland Sallai at right-back, a role he covers rather than his natural position, with Eren Elmali occupying the left side opposite him.
